title: Genie Migrate can convert T-SQL to Lakeflow pipelines (Beta)
body:
Genie Migrate can convert T-SQL scripts from SQL Server and Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools into Lakeflow pipelines. This target framework is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). In a T-SQL migration project, choose the **Spark Declarative Pipelines** target framework, organize your files into groups, and choose a catalog and schema for each group. Each group becomes one serverless pipeline that Genie Migrate validates with a dry run. To use this target, a workspace admin turns on **Migration Projects Experimental Features** from the **Previews** page. See [Manage Databricks previews](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews).

See [Supported source dialects and target frameworks](/aws/en/migration/genie-migrate/convert#supported-sources).
